fields.details: 0 to 10000 ms, standard 500 ms. Applies to setup → main phase and main phase → shutdown in all scenes. Movement and separate soft-on/off ramps remain independent functions.

fields.label: Segment number of the effect
fields.short: 2 to 100 recurring effect segments.
fields.details: Common value for setup/main phase/deactivation. Do not confuse with physical string segments of an output. The integral pixel space can limit the visible division.

fields.label: Luminous component per effect segment
fields.short: 1 to 100% of the segment area.
fields.details: Defines the spatial geometry together with the number of segments. Small values for short segments can only be displayed with whole pixels. The old soft segment edge is removed.

fields.label: Second presence object (byte)
fields.short: DP 8: 0 finished, positive byte values maintain presence.
fields.details: This object can never turn on itself and does not set any brightness. It works parallel to DP 7; the last telegram that has been received. Only activate if a corresponding detector is actually linked.

fields.label: Mix scene overlap
fields.short: Determine how two scenes are mixed during “Start the Nearest Scene Previously”. Mean: Color and brightness of both scenes are averaged, can show a brightness jump at the beginning and end of the overlap. Time weighted: constantly from the old to the new scene, without jump, in the middle somewhat darker. Adds: both scenes glow over each other, the soft-on/out ramps determine the course; where both are brighter at the same time, it becomes brighter. Applies to all scenes and outputs.
fields.details: Selection: average / time weighted / added (limited). See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Active
fields.short: Enables or disables this sequence. When disabled, all values remain stored, but the sequence is not offered through KNX or Control.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Name / label
fields.short: Custom display name of the sequence. It appears in Control, selection fields and the sequence overview.
fields.details: Character maximum: 31. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Scene pool
fields.short: Add to the KNX scene pool. The KNX object next/previous scene only switches through pool scenes (telegram 1 = forward, 0 = back), ascending with circulation.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Start effect
fields.short: Animation used when the sequence is switched on, before the main phase begins. No start effect means starting the main phase immediately.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Start-effect Duration s
fields.short: Duration of the setup or shut-off phase. In the form in seconds, stored internally in milliseconds. 0 uses the automatic effect duration; an unlimited main phase is separated from it.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 10000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: start_always_execute
fields.short: Also performs the structure of this scene when changing from an already running scene. If the previous scene “Switch: Always Run” is activated, its shutdown phase is terminated first.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: soft_on_enabled
fields.short: Softens the scene when switched on from AUS. Overwhelms the previous scene with “Start the Next Scene Previously” into this scene, the fading takes over the fading in and Gentle One is not applied.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Gentle One Duration S
fields.short: Gentle One Duration 0 to 10000 ms in 100 ms increments. Longer means slower blinding.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 10000; Steps: 100. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: start_tail
fields.short: Running effects leave a softly sloping tail behind them in the starting phase. The tail length is under afterglow percent.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: start_color_enabled
fields.short: Show structure in its own color. Without hooks, the structure uses the main phase color, i.e. the scene color or the value last set by KNX.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: R
fields.short: Red part of the build-up color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: G
fields.short: Green content of the build-up color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: B
fields.short: Blue component of the build-up color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: WHERE
fields.short: White component of the build-up color, 0 to 255. Only works with RGBW LEDs.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: While ON
fields.short: Effect used during the main phase while the sequence is on. Off means everything remains dark after the start effect.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Main duration s
fields.short: Duration of the main phase in seconds. 0.0 = lasting until the sequence is terminated by KNX or control. A value greater than 0 then automatically starts the out effect.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 129600000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Sparkling speed s
fields.short: Joint distance between new sparks in construction, main phase and shutdown. Smaller = denser flutter.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Funkel degree of filling %%
fields.short: Common share of simultaneously sparkling LEDs in all three phases.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 100. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Sparkling life s
fields.short: Joint lighting and glowing time of a spark in all three phases.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Pulse/blink period s (all phases)
fields.short: Common duration of a pulse or flash cycle in setup, main phase and disconnection.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 86400000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: main_tail
fields.short: Running effects leave a softly sloping tail behind them in the main phase.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: % % % (all phases)
fields.short: Common tail length for shafts in construction, main phase and disconnection.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 200. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Off effect
fields.short: Animation used when the sequence ends after the main phase or an off command. Immediate off switches off without animation.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Out-effect Duration s
fields.short: Duration of the setup or shut-off phase. In the form in seconds, stored internally in milliseconds. 0 uses the automatic effect duration; an unlimited main phase is separated from it.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 10000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: end_always_execute
fields.short: Completely executes the shut-off phase of this scene even when changing to another scene. The new scene will start.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: soft_off_enabled
fields.short: Unlocks the scene softly when it is turned off. When changing to another scene, Sanft Aus will not be applied as long as “Next scene sooner starts” is above 0 and this scene will run an out-effect – then the remnant takes over.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Gentle-out-duration
fields.short: Gentle-out duration 0 to 10000 ms in 100 ms increments. In the case of spatial end effects, already deleted pixels remain.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 10000; Steps: 100. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: end_tail
fields.short: Running effects leave a softly sloping tail behind them in the switch-off phase.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: end_color_enabled
fields.short: Turn off in your own color. Without a hook, the switch-off uses the main phase color, i.e. the scene color or the value last set by KNX.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: R
fields.short: Red part of the switch-off color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: G
fields.short: Green part of the switch-off color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: B
fields.short: Blue part of the switch-off color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: WHERE
fields.short: White part of the switch-off color, 0 to 255. Only works with RGBW LEDs.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Next Scene Previous Start S
fields.short: The following scene starts so many seconds before the end of the out-effect of this scene. Both run simultaneously during this time and are hidden after “Mixing Scene Overlapping”. At most as long as the out-effect duration. If this scene does not run out when changing, it will be softly hidden over this time instead. 0 = consecutive.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: R
fields.short: Red component of the scene color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: G

fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: B
fields.short: Blue component of the scene color, 0 to 255.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: WHERE
fields.short: White component of the scene color, 0 to 255. It affects RGBW LEDs only; on RGB the value has no effect.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Scene brightness (master)
fields.short: Separate master value: scales the entire scene including white and is then limited by the output limits. Color brightness in the picker is HSV V and changes R/G/B only.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Filling degree % % (all phases)
fields.short: Common degree of filling for construction, main phase and shutdown. 100 = whole ledge.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 100. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: # Pixel
fields.short: Fixed number of affected LEDs if Affected LEDs is set to Absolute. Applies to all phases.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 5000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Step time s (all phases)
fields.short: Common seconds per pixel step for running light, waves and random setup in all phases. Smaller = faster.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Starting distance between outputs s
fields.short: It only works at the global start of a process. Output 1 starts immediately, output 2 after simple and output 3 after double distance.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: String segments Start offset per segment s
fields.short: For outputs with string segments, delays each subsequent segment by this value when switching on.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Stop distance per segment/output s
fields.short: Stuffed off: for string segments per segment, otherwise for each output.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60000. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Speed
fields.short: Case speed 0 to 255. 0 = random tempo for each block as in the WLED standard; 1 to 255 = fixed speed.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Block width
fields.short: WLED width scale 0 to 255. 0 = random size per block; Long strands receive proportionally larger blocks.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 255. See the detailed instructions on scenes.

fields.label: Status interval
fields.short: Cycle time for automatic status telegrams. Only used with By time or Change and time.
fields.details: Selection: 1 s / 5 s / 10 s / 30 s / 1 min / 5 min / 10 min / 30 min / 1 h. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Current values, dead band (mA)
fields.short: How much a current value must deviate before it is sent again. 0 sends every change. A transition from or to 0 mA is always sent.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Steps: 1. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Current values, minimum interval (s)
fields.short: Shortest gap between two telegrams of the same current object. 0 sends every relevant change immediately.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Steps: 1. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Current values, cyclic refresh (s)
fields.short: Cyclic repetition even without a change. 0 switches it off. It must not be shorter than the minimum interval.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Steps: 1. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: utilisation change (%)
fields.short: Re-send as soon as the rolling real-time load has changed at least by this percentage value. 0 takes into account any change.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Steps: 1. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Loading Minimum distance (s)
fields.short: Shortest distance between two telegrams of the load object.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Steps: 1. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Refreshment (s)
fields.short: Cyclic repetition of the utilisation value even without change. 0 turns it off; the value shall not be less than the minimum distance.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Steps: 1. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Ready for operation Refreshment (s)
fields.short: Cyclic repetition of the life sign KLC status ready for operation. 0 sends only when changing.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Steps: 1. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Switch-on speed
fields.short: Switch-on duration in seconds. 0 switches immediately; a larger value means a slower transition.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60; Steps: 0.001. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Switch-off speed
fields.short: Switch-off duration in seconds. 0 switches immediately; a larger value means a slower transition.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 60; Steps: 0.001. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Turn on
fields.short: Determines what is switched on with a KNX switching telegram with value 1.
fields.details: Selection: Last value/scene/fixed values/fixed scene. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Fixed scene
fields.short: This scene is started with value 1 when the KNX is switched on.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: KNX base scene
fields.short: Fallback scene for switching-on KNX color or brightness telegrams if no active or last used scene has been present since restarting.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: knx_scene_switch_on
fields.short: Scene object: ON = Scenes 1 to 30 Apply immediately; AUS = Scene only for the next regular turn-on. Scene 0 always switches off immediately.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: knx_brightness_switch_on
fields.short: Brightness object: ON = positive value may switch on a switched-off output; OFF = positive value, when the output is switched off, is only recorded for the next regular turn-on.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: knx_brightness_switch_off
fields.short: Brightness object: ON = value 0 switches off via the configured fade logic; EX = value 0 is ignored.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Red
fields.short: Fixed red content when switching on, 0 to 100 percent.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 100. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Green
fields.short: Fixed green content when switched on, 0 to 100 percent.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 100. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Blue
fields.short: Fixed blue content when switched on, 0 to 100 percent.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 100. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: White
fields.short: Fixed white content when switched on, 0 to 100 percent.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 100. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Lock active at
fields.short: Determines whether value 0 or value 1 activates the blocking object of this output.
fields.details: Selection: 0 active / 1 active. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Lock active
fields.short: Action that is executed immediately when the lock is activated.
fields.details: Selection: Unchanged / Off / In. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Lock released
fields.short: Action that is executed immediately when unlocking. A previous condition is not automatically restored.
fields.details: Selection: Unchanged / Off / In. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: Force object active at
fields.short: Determines which KNX value activates the force object.
fields.details: Selection: 0 active / 1 active. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: When force object active
fields.short: Action while the force object is active. This overrides normal scene commands.
fields.details: Selection: From / One. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: When force object released
fields.short: Action when the force object is released again.
fields.details: Selection: Unchanged / Off / In. See the detailed instructions for the KNX area.

fields.label: WiFi client (wlan0)
fields.short: Connects the controller as a client to the home network WLAN. Independent of the access point.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on the network area.

fields.label: WiFi
fields.short: Master switch for the radio module: enables or disables the Wi-Fi client and access point together. Recovery without Web UI: hold the service button for at least 2 real seconds; hold count 3-4.
fields.details: See the detailed instructions on the network area.

fields.label: WLAN SSID
fields.short: Name of the WLAN network to which the client should connect. Only 2.4 GHz networks are supported.
fields.details: Sign maximum: 32. See the detailed instructions on the network area.

fields.label: WiFi password

fields.label: Wireless DHCP

fields.label: WiFi Static IP
fields.short: Fixed IP address of the WLAN client when WLAN DHCP is off.

fields.label: Wi-Fi

fields.label: WiFi subnet

fields.label: Wi-Fi

fields.label: Subnet
fields.short: Subnet mask for Ethernet with static address, usually 255.255.255.0.

fields.label: Output sequence active
fields.short: Activates the relevant function. A turned-off hook is not to be equalized with a dark but active scene.

fields.label: Restart run-on on a new trigger

fields.label: Shared run-on (s)
fields.short: Common follow-up of the output sequence in seconds, max. 24 hours.
fields.details: Minimum: 0; Maximum: 86400; Steps: 0.001. See the detailed instructions on the starting sequence section.

fields.label: Switch-off order
fields.short: Selects simultaneous, reversed or custom turn-off following the turn-on sequence. Times count from the start of the switch-off sequence.

fields.label: Enable presence function
fields.short: Enables DP 7. Status operation: 1 stops, 0 starts run. Trigger operation: each 1 extended, 0 is ignored.

fields.label: Presence run-on (s)

fields.label: Switch-on direction

fields.label: Threshold (lx)

fields.label: Password

fields.label: role

fields.label: Language
fields.short: Persistent language of the surface and selection of the appropriate help package.
fields.details: Selection: German / English / Français / Español / Italiano / Nederlands / Polski. See the detailed instructions on the device section.

fields.label: New user password
fields.short: Enter new password; not empty and no more than 64 characters. The second input must be identical.

fields.label: Repeat new user password
fields.short: Repeat new password to avoid typing errors identically.

fields.label: KLC Central One Off (DP 1)
fields.short: 0: parameterized switch-off. 1: configured switch-on action for each released output.
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 1; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-1.001; 1 byte(s); Range 0..1. Example group address: 2/2/1. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC Central Scene (DP 2)
fields.short: Starts the specified KLC scene centrally; inconsistent scenes are rejected
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 2; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPT-5.005; 1 byte(s); Range 0..30 (transport 0..255). Example group address: 2/2/2. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC Central Brightness (DP 3)
fields.short: Sets the absolute brightness of all released outputs; each output reports its own status.
fields.details: BAOS data point 3, input, DPT 5.001, 1 byte: 0 to 255 correspond to 0 to 100%. Output-specific switch-on releases as well as lock and forced control continue to apply. This object is active, not reserved.

fields.label: KLC Central Scene Continue to the Eye (DP 4)
fields.short: 0 = previous, 1 = next scene in the central scene pool
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 4; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-1.001; 1 byte(s); Range 0..1. Example group address: 2/2/4. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC output sequence trigger A (DP 5)
fields.short: 1 starts the configured output sequence direction A; 0 don't run a sequence
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 5; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-1.001; 1 byte(s); Range 0..1. Example group address: 2/2/5. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC output sequence trigger B (DP 6)
fields.short: 1 starts the configured output sequence direction B; 0 don't run a sequence
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 6; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-1.001; 1 byte(s); Range 0..1. Example group address: 2/2/6. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC Tracking Praesence (DP 7)
fields.short: Status operation: 1 ticks the active output sequence, 0 starts the Praesenz follow-up. Trigger operation: each 1-telegram restarts the Praesenz follow-up, 0 has no effect. In status operation, the firmware actively reads the current value after a BAOS connection; this start-read does not trigger a scene start. From Scheme 6, there is a second, parallel impact object with 1 byte payload with DP 8.; DP 7 itself remains strict 0/1.
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 7; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-1.001; 1 byte(s); Range 0..1. Example group address: 2/2/7. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC Tracking Praesence Keep Byte (DP 8)
fields.short: Second property with 1 byte payload. It works parallel to DP 7 and has the same sensitivity: 0 it ends, JEDER value groesser 0 hives it - without threshold. Designed for detectors that send a dimming value in the evening; the controller derives NO brightness from this. The object can never turn on, even in presence_can_start: it exclusively has a running sequence. There is no precedence rule between DP 7 and DP 8, and the last telegram that has been entered applies. In status operation, the firmware also actively reads this object after a BAOS connection; the start-read does not start scenes.
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 8; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-5.001; 1 byte(s); Range 0..255 (0 = keine Praesenz, alles darueber haelt). Example group address: 2/2/8. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC output sequence Brightness (DP 9)
fields.short: Brightness of an external detector. The lock is exclusively denounced BEIM TRIGGER, never running: the own LED outputs illuminate the measuring location and otherwise the system would be switched off immediately after switching on. Comparative direction, threshold and hysteresis are configurable in the firmware. As long as no value has arrived after the start, it is not blocked.
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 9; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-9.004; 2 byte(s); Range 0..100000 lx (ausgewertet). Example group address: 2/2/9. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC Central Color Red (DP 10)

fields.details: BAOS datapoint 10; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-5.001; 1 byte(s); Range 0..255 = 0..100 %. Example group address: 2/2/10. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.short: Only 1 calls for restart; 0 ignored. Run at the intended safe point, running storage operations are taken into account.
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 14; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-1.015; 1 byte(s); Range 1 = Neustart, 0 = ohne Wirkung. Example group address: 2/2/180. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC Werksreset (DP 15)
fields.short: Only code word 165 (0xA5) requires complete set of works. Lost facility; Return via profile-dependent network access/assistant. Consciously link to ETS.
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 15; KNX -> KLC; Data type DPST-5.010; 1 byte(s); Range 165 (0xA5) loest aus, jeder andere Wert wird verworfen. Example group address: 2/2/181. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.label: KLC Status Total current (DP 17)
fields.short: Rated current after limitation. Deadband, minimum distance and refreshment are configurable in the firmware.
fields.details: BAOS datapoint 17; KLC -> KNX; Data type DPST-14.019; 4 byte(s); Range 0..50 A. Example group address: 2/2/22. Check the actual ETS group-address links in your installation.

fields.short: Time/date input for readable time stamps. Time and date together result in a complete local time; TLS requires a reliably assigned UTC time.

fields.short: Time/date input for readable time stamps. Time and date together result in a complete local time; TLS requires a reliably assigned UTC time.

fields.label: Output of a step
fields.short: Selects the physical output that is addressed in this step. Note assignment and chain formation under outputs.
fields.details: The setting exists separately per step and per sequence A/B. Save changes in the form. A test can switch real LEDs.

fields.label: Start time of a step
fields.short: Time offset 0 to 86400 seconds from start of the respective sequence, resolution 0.001 seconds. Same times start together.
fields.details: The setting exists separately per step and per sequence A/B. Save changes in the form. A test can switch real LEDs.

fields.label: Action of a step
fields.short: Last setting uses the last known light state; Scene uses the scene space chosen under it.
fields.details: The setting exists separately per step and per sequence A/B. Save changes in the form. A test can switch real LEDs.

fields.label: Scene of a Step
fields.short: Select scene number 1 to 30 for the step. Save the scene content beforehand under scenes; the selection does not copy or alter the scene.
fields.details: The setting exists separately per step and per sequence A/B. Save changes in the form. A test can switch real LEDs.

fields.label: Use step
fields.short: Hook activates this line of sequence A; the same setting exists per line in A and B. Unused lines are not executed.
fields.details: Separately set per line and save the form.

fields.label: Output for custom turn-off
fields.short: Select output for this own switch-off step. Only effective in the user-defined switch-off mode.
fields.details: Separately set per line and save the form.

fields.label: Time when user-defined turn-off
fields.short: Replacement from the start of the turn-off sequence in seconds, not from the original turn-on.
fields.details: Separately set per line and save the form.

fields.label: Determine the number of visible scenes.
fields.short: Determine the number of visible scenes.
fields.details: The number controls the scenes offered. Existing scene data are not deleted by the mere selection of a smaller ad. Scene 0 stays out.

fields.label: Set preview at this time.
fields.short: Set preview at this time.
fields.details: Moves only the browser preview. A real output is only started with the output test. Phase selection, speed and duration influence the position shown.

fields.label: Select your destination; Copy overwrites his scene.
fields.short: Select your destination; Copy overwrites his scene.
fields.details: Before copying, check the target area. The source space is preserved. Copy replaces the settings of the target location; a scene export secures the previous stand.

fields.label: Select scene for the subsequent start.
fields.short: Select scene for the subsequent start.
fields.details: The selection alone does not start any LEDs yet. Start acts on the designated output or the global range. Ends the output; Locking and forced control may have priority.

fields.label: Current per LED at full intensity of this color channel.
fields.short: Current per LED at full intensity of this color channel.
fields.details: Indication in mA per LED. The four values describe red, green, blue and the separate white canal. They are a computational model, no measurement in operation. Standby and controller base current are taken into account separately.

fields.label: Enter measured total current in this test color channel.
fields.short: Enter measured total current in this test color channel.
fields.details: Make the measurement LED number and selected output unchanged. Measure the current at the power supply in mA. The calculation takes off the out-current and splits by the number of measurement LEDs. W only use for RGBW.

fields.label: Use this switch-off step.
fields.short: Use this switch-off step.
fields.details: Applies in custom shut-off mode. Only activated lines are executed. Determine output and offset separately from the start of switch-off per line.

fields.label: Choose appropriate local firmware as .bin or .bin.gz.
fields.short: Choose appropriate local firmware as .bin or .bin.gz.
fields.details: The file must fit the board profile. The Webupload does not accept UF2 file. After successful writing, the device restarts. Back up backup before; receive the power supply during the writing.

fields.label: Select configuration backup as JSON for testing.
fields.short: Select configuration backup as JSON for testing.
fields.details: The file selection alone does not import anything. The import checks format, scheme and values. Missing WLAN passwords may have to be re-entered on another device. A full-backup and a scene export are different files.

fields.label: Select Scene Export as JSON for testing.
fields.short: Select Scene Export as JSON for testing.
fields.details: First check, then trigger the released import. Observe test result and target occupancy; existing scenes can be replaced. A configuration backup is not a scene export.

fields.label: Read diagnostic data or mark it for copying.
fields.short: Read diagnostic data or mark it for copying.
fields.details: Reload queries the current snapshot. Copy only the displayed text in clipboard; Select it for manual copying. This does not open a support case and does not send a message.

fields.label: Limit the scope of assistance to one subject area.
fields.short: Limit the scope of assistance to one subject area.
fields.details: All areas only lift the range filter. The search text entered is preserved. Remove search resets both filters.

fields.label: Choose shade and saturation; Arrow keys are also possible.
fields.short: Choose shade and saturation; Arrow keys are also possible.
fields.details: On the outside is full saturation, inside the color becomes whiter. The angle determines the hue. The color brightness is a separate controller; the RGBW white channel is separated. The color wheel changes the assigned RGB inputs.

fields.label: Change RGB color brightness; White and scene brightness remain separate.
fields.short: Change RGB color brightness; White and scene brightness remain separate.
fields.details: HSV-V scales the RGB components. The scene brightness then scales the scene. Maximum output brightness and current limits additionally work. For color brightness 0, RGB is initially black.

fields.label: Enter RGB color as a six-digit hex value.
fields.short: Enter RGB color as a six-digit hex value.
fields.details: Format #RRGGBB, for example #FF0000 for red. White is not included. The value describes RGB before scene brightness and output limit. Invalid inputs do not give a valid new color.

fields.label: Set separate white channel; only works at RGBW.
fields.short: Set separate white channel; only works at RGBW.
fields.details: The controller changes W, not RGB. A separate white channel is missing for pure RGB outputs. RGB white from three channels and W can have different color temperatures and current recordings.

fields.label: Set time in the next unit.
fields.short: Set time in the next unit.
fields.details: Visible seconds are stored internally in milliseconds. Pay attention to resolution and admissible range. 0 has its own meaning depending on the function; the field-related help explains it.

fields.label: Use Wi-Fi in the facility.
fields.short: Use Wi-Fi in the facility.
fields.details: Only for hardware with WLAN. Without Wi-Fi, the device can take place via Ethernet. The selection does not replace SSID or password. Check a connection that can be reached before closing.

fields.label: This WLAN does not need a password.
fields.short: This WLAN does not need a password.
fields.details: Select only for a truly unencrypted network. Specify otherwise password. The selection refers to the target Wi-Fi, not to the service access point.

fields.label: Select target WiFi or enter its name.
fields.short: Select target WiFi or enter its name.
fields.details: A search shows accessible networks. A hidden network can be entered manually. SSID and large/small spelling must vote. A scan does not connect the device yet.

fields.label: Enter the password of the selected WLAN.
fields.short: Enter the password of the selected WLAN.
fields.details: The password belongs to the target Wi-Fi and not to the administrator access. Select Open Networks via the option provided for this purpose. After a failed test SSID, check password and signal.

fields.label: Request registration for normal operation.
fields.short: Request registration for normal operation.
fields.details: Without this option, normal operation without user registration is possible. Protected administrator actions continue to demand the admin role. consciously decide before sharing in your own network.

fields.label: Set password for the designated user role.
fields.short: Set password for the designated user role.
fields.details: User and administrator password are separated. Not empty and maximum of 64 characters. Confirmation must be identical. Maintain standard passwords only consciously through the confirmation provided for this purpose.

fields.label: Repeat the new password identically.
fields.short: Repeat the new password identically.
fields.details: Count large/small spelling and spaces. In the case of deviating inputs, the step cannot be completed in a valid manner. Do not enter the WLAN password.

fields.label: Keep the displayed default password consciously.
fields.short: Keep the displayed default password consciously.
fields.details: The confirmation replaces a separate password selection for the respective role. User standards and admin standards differ. Change under safety during regular operation.

fields.label: Select a bright or dark representation.
fields.short: Select a bright or dark representation.
fields.details: The representation does not alter LED colors or output brightnesses. In the wizard, the selection applies first to the institution; confirm the degree.

fields.label: Save
fields.short: Check and save values of this form.
fields.details: Only the values of the associated form are taken over. Note error message or restart note. In the case of an output structure, it is not immediately active; the new structure is tested during restarting.

fields.label: Log in
fields.short: Log in with the selected role.
fields.details: Users and admins have separate passwords and permissions. A failed application does not switch any LEDs. Re-enroll in the session and reload the form.

fields.label: Log out
fields.short: End the current session.
fields.details: The light output continues. Further protected actions require a new registration; saved configuration is preserved.

fields.label: Adopt rescue copy and restart
fields.short: Save checked rescue copy and restart device.
fields.details: Writes the validated previous configuration as a new active file and restarts. The existing rescue copy remains protected during the commit. Before checking the displayed configuration state and the source.

fields.label: Retry authority commit
fields.short: Try to confirm the already tested scene bench again.
fields.details: In the case of an interrupted commit, the existing confirmed bank is taken into account. Read the diagnosis note before the new test. The action is not an arbitrary resetting of all scenes.

fields.label: Restore confirmed bank
fields.short: Restore last confirmed scene bench.
fields.details: Restoration uses the validly confirmed bank. A new, unconfirmed stand will not become the authority. In the case of a damaged memory, first secure export or support data, as far as available.

fields.label: Cancel
fields.short: Close this selection without performing the action.
fields.details: Set the open dialog or the selection. Separately stored changes are not undone. Please note open unstored form values per page.

fields.label: Automatic
fields.short: Evaluate Lux Release automatically.
fields.details: Pick up the manual release/sperre. The last valid lux value and configured comparison will again determine the release; the test works at the start trigger.

fields.label: Permanently free
fields.short: Set Luxsperre manually to free.
fields.details: The manual release overrides the automatic lux decision, not lock or forced control of an output. With automatic return to normal lux evaluation.

fields.label: Permanently locked
fields.short: Lock new start triggers through the Lux release.
fields.details: This lock is the manual brightness release of the output sequence. It is not a global KNX forced control and does not end any issue by the name alone. Automatically activate the Lux evaluation again.

fields.label: Initiate direction A
fields.short: The corresponding output sequence now triggers real.
fields.details: This is an effective start trigger and no browser preview. Activation, lux release, presence logic as well as exit locks continue to apply. The direction determines the configured sequence of steps.

fields.label: See more topics
fields.short: See more results from the already loaded help.
fields.details: Shows up to 40 more hits. The search includes all entries from the start; the limitation relates only to the simultaneously rendered articles.

fields.label: Cancel automatic installation
fields.short: Cancel the currently featured automatic installation.
fields.details: The action cancels the pending automatic installation. Permanent settings such as Auto-Check and Auto-Install separately check and save if necessary.

fields.label: Search for update
fields.short: Online search for firmware for this board profile.
fields.details: The search is not yet installed. Network, DNS and reliable time for HTTPS must be available. Stable/Beta depends on the selected channel.

fields.label: Restart later
fields.short: Hide restart notice in this view.
fields.details: Saved pending changes will remain stored. Hide doesn't activate them and doesn't reject them. The next restart continues to try to activate.

fields.label: Install beta now
fields.short: Install Firmware offers and then restart.
fields.details: Check profile and available version. Back up backup before. After the start of writing, receive power supply. The controller is not normally operable during restart and bootloader.

fields.label: Discard changes
fields.short: Unstored values of this page discard.
fields.details: resets the current processing to the stored stand or reloads it. Changes already successfully stored are not undone thereby.

fields.label: car hire
fields.short: Set the target for the power measurement.
fields.details: Defines the desired image distance for diagnostic comparisons. Small distance requires more computing time. Use the same scene, output number and pixel number when comparing measurements.

fields.label: Reset test
fields.short: Restart the measurement counter of the power test.
fields.details: resets the diagnostic measurement period, not the device configuration or all scenes. After the reset, allow a comparable load to run.

fields.label: Rebuild BAOS connection
fields.short: Restart connection to the KNX-BAOS module.
fields.details: Serves the recovery of module communication. The ETS group addresses are thus not reprogrammed. Telegrams may not be processed temporarily during rebuilding.

fields.label: Request data points 1..9
fields.short: Retrieve central BAOS data points.
fields.details: Asks the specified values or descriptions from the module. This does not replace ETS links. The diagnosis shows answers and communication errors.

fields.label: Check now
fields.short: Check the status of the device function again.
fields.details: The test shall update the appropriate status display. It is not a restart and does not automatically store open forms.

fields.label: Restore embedded English
fields.short: Enable local English substitute language package.
fields.details: Serves speech reproduction in an invalid or damaged package. Changes the surface, not scenes and output parameters. A valid language package can then be selected again.

fields.label: Skip wizard
fields.short: Skip setup wizard.
fields.details: Please note the displayed indication of the condition of the device. A skipped step does not check a connection and does not replace a valid output configuration. Configuring missing values later consciously.

fields.label: Retry selected package
fields.short: Reload the language package with the available connection.
